attributes.description: Optimistic-concurrency / change version of the record.

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drugs in this program are subject to an FDA-mandated Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS). When true, dispensing requires REMS-certified pharmacy and prescriber enrollment.

tag_set.value: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag

attributes.name: specialty_drug_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specialty drug list (SDL) associated with this program, identifying the set of National Drug Codes (NDCs) covered under the program. Managed in the PBM formulary system.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_network_name
attributes.description: Name of the specialty pharmacy network designated to dispense drugs under this program. Defines the restricted network of pharmacies eligible to fill specialty prescriptions.

attributes.name: specialty_tier_designation
attributes.description: Formulary tier designation assigned to specialty drugs in this program. Determines member cost-sharing obligations and CMS Part D specialty tier reporting requirements.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are enforced for drugs in this program, requiring members to try and fail on preferred therapies before accessing specialty drugs. Governed by state step therapy laws and CMS guidance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specialty drug program is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended program with no scheduled end. Used for plan year transitions and CMS Part D reporting.

attributes.name: therapeutic_category
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic or disease category associated with the specialty drugs in this program (e.g., Oncology, Rheumatology, Multiple Sclerosis, HIV/AIDS). Used for clinical reporting, HEDIS measures, and population health analytics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Standard ECM audit/governance attribute updated_timestamp.

attributes.name: wac_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) for specialty drugs in this program. Used as an alternative pricing basis to AWP in PBM contract negotiations.

products.name: mtm_service
products.description: Record for Medication Therapy Management (MTM) services delivered to eligible members, as required under CMS Part D. Captures member eligibility criteria, MTM program enrollment date, comprehensive medication review (CMR) completion date, targeted medication review (TMR) date, pharmacist NPI, interventions recommended, medication action plan (MAP) items, follow-up status, and outcomes. Supports CMS Part D MTM reporting and STAR ratings quality measures.

attributes.name: mtm_service_id
attributes.description: Primary key for mtm_service

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Part D prescription drug plan (PDP) or Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MA-PD) plan under which the member is enrolled and MTM eligibility is determined.

attributes.name: member_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan member who received the MTM service. Links to the member master record in the core administration platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: mtm_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific MTM program offering under which this service was delivered. A plan sponsor may operate multiple MTM programs targeting different chronic condition cohorts.

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_id
attributes.description: FK to pharmacy.pharmacy_claim.pharmacy_claim_id

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: Number of qualifying chronic conditions the member has at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS Part D MTM eligibility requires a minimum number of chronic conditions (typically 2-3 depending on plan criteria). Used for eligibility validation and population stratification.

attributes.name: cmr_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the annual Comprehensive Medication Review (CMR) was completed for the member. CMS requires at least one CMR per calendar year for all enrolled MTM beneficiaries. Directly drives the CMS STAR Ratings MTM CMR Completion Rate measure.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_period
attributes.description: CMS Part D reporting period to which this MTM service record is attributed (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-ANNUAL). Used for CMS Part D MTM program reporting submissions and STAR ratings measurement year alignment.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Total number of outreach attempts made to the member to schedule or deliver the MTM service. CMS requires documentation of good-faith efforts to reach enrolled members. Used for compliance audits and outreach effectiveness analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTM service record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data-quality score for ECM scoring.

attributes.name: disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member was disenrolled or opted out of the MTM program. Null if the member remains enrolled. Used to track program retention and calculate MTM completion rates.

attributes.name: drug_therapy_problem_type
attributes.description: Primary category of drug therapy problem identified during the MTM service. Common types include: unnecessary drug therapy, needs additional drug therapy, ineffective drug, dosage too low, dosage too high, adverse drug reaction, non-adherence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UNNECESSARY_DRUG|NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_DRUG|INEFFECTIVE_DRUG|DOSE_TOO_LOW|DOSE_TOO_HIGH|ADVERSE_REACTION|NON_ADHERENCE|NONE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP-standard Drug Utilization Review (DUR) outcome code documenting the result of the pharmacist's clinical intervention during the MTM service (e.g., 1A = filled as is, 1B = filled with prescriber approval, 1C = not filled). Sourced from RxClaim or Argus PBM system DUR transaction records.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end of the record validity window.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start of the record validity window.

attributes.name: eligibility_determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member was determined to be eligible for the MTM program based on CMS Part D criteria (multiple chronic conditions, multiple Part D drugs, likely to incur annual costs above the CMS threshold).

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the eligible member was enrolled into the MTM program. CMS requires auto-enrollment of all eligible beneficiaries with opt-out capability.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_drug_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Part D Drug Cost
attributes.description: Estimated annual cost of Part D covered drugs for the member at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS requires members likely to incur annual drug costs above the established threshold to be enrolled. Expressed in USD.

tag_set.value: Estimated Annual Part D Drug Cost

attributes.name: fhir_last_updated
attributes.description: FHIR meta.lastUpdated for resource versioning

attributes.name: fhir_profile_url
attributes.description: Canonical FHIR/US Core profile URL this record conforms to

attributes.name: fhir_resource_reference
attributes.description: Stable FHIR logical resource id for interop exchange

attributes.name: fhir_resource_type
attributes.description: FHIR resource type this record maps to for interoperability (default: Basic)

attributes.name: fhir_version_code
attributes.description: FHIR meta.versionId optimistic concurrency token

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the follow-up contact or service following the MTM encounter. Null if no follow-up is required or scheduled. Used to track closure of open MAP items and clinical recommendations.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up contact or service is required after the current MTM encounter based on clinical findings or unresolved MAP items. True = follow-up required; False = no follow-up needed.

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the follow-up action required after the MTM service. PENDING = follow-up scheduled but not yet completed; COMPLETED = follow-up successfully conducted; DECLINED = member declined follow-up; UNREACHABLE = member could not be contacted for follow-up; NOT_REQUIRED = no follow-up needed.

attributes.name: intervention_count
attributes.description: Total number of clinical interventions or recommendations made during the MTM service encounter (e.g., drug therapy problem resolutions, adherence recommendations, prescriber referrals). Used for quality reporting and pharmacist productivity analytics.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Logical active flag for soft-delete and current-state filtering.

attributes.name: last_contact_attempt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent outreach attempt made to the member for MTM scheduling or delivery. Used alongside contact_attempt_count to document good-faith outreach efforts for CMS compliance.

attributes.name: map_item_count
attributes.description: Number of action items documented in the Medication Action Plan (MAP) provided to the member. Each MAP item represents a specific recommendation or goal agreed upon between the pharmacist and the member.

attributes.name: map_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a written Medication Action Plan (MAP) was provided to the member following the CMR. CMS requires a standardized MAP to be delivered to the member and their prescriber(s) after each CMR. True = MAP provided; False = MAP not yet provided.

attributes.name: master_entity_reference
attributes.description: Cross-domain master/golden entity key for SSOT resolution.

attributes.name: member_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member provided consent to participate in the MTM service and for sharing of clinical findings with their prescriber(s). True = consent obtained; False = consent not obtained or pending. Required for HIPAA compliance when sharing PHI with prescribers.

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted out of the MTM program. CMS requires auto-enrollment with opt-out capability. True = member has opted out; False = member remains enrolled. When True, disenrollment_date should be populated.

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the member's opt-out or disenrollment from the MTM program. Null if the member has not opted out. Used for program retention analysis and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: part_d_drug_count
attributes.description: Number of Part D covered drugs the member is taking at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS Part D MTM eligibility requires a minimum number of Part D drugs (typically 8 or more). Used for eligibility validation.

attributes.name: pbm_member_code
attributes.description: Member identifier assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus) used to cross-reference the MTM record with pharmacy claims and formulary data.

attributes.name: personal_medication_list_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Personal Medication List (PML) was provided to the member as part of the CMR standardized format. CMS requires both a MAP and a PML to be delivered following each CMR. True = PML provided; False = PML not provided.

attributes.name: pharmacist_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the pharmacist or clinical pharmacist who delivered the MTM service, including Comprehensive Medication Review (CMR) or Targeted Medication Review (TMR). Required for CMS Part D MTM reporting.

attributes.name: pharmacist_recommendation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text clinical notes documenting the pharmacist's recommendations, findings, and interventions during the MTM service encounter. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI) and must be handled in accordance with HIPAA Privacy Rule requirements.

attributes.name: prescriber_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prescriber(s) were notified of the MTM service findings and MAP items. Null if notification has not yet been sent. Used for compliance tracking against CMS timelines.

attributes.name: prescriber_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's prescriber(s) were notified of the MTM service findings, recommendations, or MAP items. CMS requires that the MAP and relevant clinical findings be shared with the prescriber. True = prescriber notified; False = notification pending or not completed.

attributes.name: record_created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp the record was created (audit lineage).

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: System of record / source system that produced this record (SSOT provenance).

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Standard ECM audit/governance attribute record_status.

attributes.name: record_updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp the record was last updated (audit lineage).

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Optimistic-concurrency / change version of the record.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the MTM service (CMR, TMR, or follow-up) was delivered to the member. This is the principal real-world event date used for CMS Part D MTM reporting and STAR ratings quality measure calculations.

attributes.name: service_delivery_channel
attributes.description: Mode through which the MTM service was delivered to the member. CMS requires CMRs to be offered as interactive, person-to-person consultations (in-person or telehealth). Supports channel-level analytics and compliance verification.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the MTM service encounter in minutes. Used for pharmacist productivity reporting, billing reconciliation with PBM, and quality analytics. CMR encounters typically range from 30 to 60 minutes.

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MTM service record. SCHEDULED = appointment set; IN_PROGRESS = service initiated; COMPLETED = service fully delivered and documented; DECLINED = member declined participation; UNREACHABLE = member could not be contacted; CANCELLED = service cancelled prior to delivery.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MTM service delivered. CMR = Comprehensive Medication Review (annual face-to-face or telehealth); TMR = Targeted Medication Review (quarterly or as needed); FOLLOW_UP = follow-up contact on prior CMR/TMR; REFERRAL = referral to prescriber or specialist; OTHER = other MTM-related service.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this MTM service record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across PBM (RxClaim/Argus) and Care Management (Casenet TruCare/Altruista) platforms.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating source system (RxClaim, Argus, Casenet TruCare, or Altruista) for this MTM service record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: star_measure_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTM service record is eligible to be counted toward the CMS STAR Ratings MTM Completion Rate for Comprehensive Medication Reviews (CMR) quality measure. True = eligible for STAR measure numerator/denominator; False = excluded from STAR measure calculation.

attributes.name: tmr_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Targeted Medication Review (TMR) was conducted. TMRs are performed at least quarterly for enrolled members who have not yet received a CMR or as clinically indicated. Null if no TMR has been performed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTM service record was last modified in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: formulary_exception
products.description: Transactional record for member or prescriber requests to cover a non-formulary drug or override a formulary restriction (tier exception, PA exception, step therapy exception). Captures request date, member ID, prescriber NPI, requested drug NDC, exception type, clinical justification, decision status (approved/denied), effective date range, and appeal rights notification. Supports CMS Part D coverage determination and exception request requirements.

attributes.name: formulary_exception_id
attributes.description: Primary key for formulary_exception

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated appeal record if the member or prescriber has filed an appeal against a denied formulary exception. Links to the appeals management entity. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Formulary exception requests are reviewed under regulatory obligations; linking captures which obligation governs each exception.

attributes.name: credential_record_id
attributes.description: add column credential_record_id (BIGINT) with FK to credential.record.record_id - exception requested by credentialed prescriber

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical pharmacist, pharmacy technician, or medical director who reviewed and rendered the decision on the formulary exception request. Links to the workforce/staff entity.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific formulary against which the exception is being evaluated. A plan may maintain multiple formularies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid). Links to the formulary master in the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus).

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health benefit plan under which the formulary exception is being requested. Determines the applicable formulary, tier structure, and exception adjudication rules.

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan member on whose behalf the formulary exception request is submitted. Links to the member master record in the core administration platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Identifier of an associated Prior Authorization (PA) request in the UM system (InterQual/MCG) when the formulary exception is linked to or triggered by a PA requirement. Null if no PA is associated.

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial. Required for CMS Part D compliance tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial decision, as mandated by CMS Part D regulations. True = notification sent; False = notification not yet sent.

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text clinical rationale provided by the prescriber or member supporting the formulary exception request. May include diagnosis, treatment history, contraindications to formulary alternatives, or medical necessity documentation. Treated as confidential clinical information.

attributes.name: cms_coverage_determination_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type
attributes.description: CMS-defined classification of the coverage determination process type for Part D reporting. Standard: routine 72-hour review; Expedited: 24-hour urgent review; Reopen: plan-initiated reconsideration; Revised: updated determination on a prior decision.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the formulary exception record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: current_drug_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier at which the requested drug is currently placed (or non_formulary if not on the formulary) at the time the exception request is submitted. Used to assess the tier differential and cost-sharing impact of the exception. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|tier_4|tier_5|specialty|non_formulary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data-quality score for ECM scoring.

attributes.name: days_supply_requested
attributes.description: Number of days of drug supply requested in the formulary exception, applicable for quantity limit or day supply override exceptions. Standard values are 30, 60, or 90 days.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the final determination (approval or denial) was made on the formulary exception request. Used to calculate turnaround time and assess CMS timeliness compliance.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the exception determination was rendered. Enables exact measurement of response time against CMS 72-hour standard and 24-hour expedited decision deadlines.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for denial of the formulary exception request (e.g., formulary alternative available, insufficient clinical documentation, drug not medically necessary). Null for approved or pending requests. Used in EOB and appeal rights notifications.

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the reason for denial of the formulary exception request. Included in the written notice of denial sent to the member and prescriber as required by CMS Part D regulations.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10-CM) diagnosis code supporting the medical necessity of the requested drug. Provided by the prescriber as part of the clinical justification for the exception. Treated as confidential health information.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the drug for which the formulary exception is requested, as submitted by the requestor. Stored for human-readable reference alongside the NDC code.

attributes.name: drug_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code (NDC) of the specific drug product for which the formulary exception is requested. Identifies the labeler, product, and package configuration at the NDC level.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which an approved formulary exception remains valid. After this date, the member must reapply or the standard formulary restriction resumes. Null for open-ended approvals or non-approved requests.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which an approved formulary exception is valid and the member may obtain the drug at the excepted tier or without the formulary restriction. Null for denied or pending requests.

attributes.name: exception_request_number

products.name: benefit_accumulator
products.description: Tracks member-level pharmacy benefit accumulator balances including deductible applied, out-of-pocket (OOP) spend, maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) progress, true out-of-pocket (TrOOP) for Medicare Part D, initial coverage limit (ICL) progress, and catastrophic coverage threshold. Supports real-time cost-sharing calculation at point of sale, coverage gap (donut hole) determination for Part D members, low-income subsidy (LIS) cost-sharing adjustments, and member Explanation of Benefits (EOB) generation. Critical for CMS Part D benefit phase tracking and annual reconciliation.

products.name: pharmacy_claim2
products.description: Core transactional record for each pharmacy claim submitted and adjudicated through the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus). Header captures: claim number, member ID, prescriber NPI, dispensing pharmacy NPI, NDC, days supply, quantity dispensed, fill date, adjudication date, claim status, reject codes, ingredient cost, dispensing fee, copay, coinsurance, deductible applied, plan paid amount, and coordination of benefits (COB) details. Line-level detail supports multi-ingredient compound claims and COB line splits: line sequence, per-ingredient NDC, ingredient cost, dispensing fee, sales tax, incentive amount, other payer amount, patient pay amount, and basis of cost determination. Supports NCPDP D.0 transaction standards, 835 remittance, CMS Part D encounter data submissions (EDPS/RAPS), 340B claim identification for duplicate discount prevention, and pharmacy audit trail requirements. This is the SSOT for all pharmacy claim header and line-level transactional data within the pharmacy domain.

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim2_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pharmacy claim record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the pharmacy_claim data product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_payment. Business justification: AP Payment Recording: payment of the AP invoice for a claim is tracked to close the reimbursement cycle.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to appeal.appeal_case. Business justification: Required for the 'Pharmacy Claim Appeal' process where each claim can generate an appeal case; enables claim‑level appeal reporting and tracking.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Claim adjudication uses PBM contract rates, step‑therapy and rebate rules; linking claim to provider_contract enables accurate pricing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost‑Center Allocation: claim expense is allocated to the appropriate cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the pharmacy that dispensed the drug. Links to the provider/pharmacy master record. Distinguishes retail, mail-order, and specialty pharmacy channels. Used for network adequacy reporting and pharmacy audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the NDC-level drug master record in the pharmacy domain. Links to the formulary drug master product which carries NDC, drug name, tier, and pricing (AWP/WAC/MAC). Central to formulary compliance and drug utilization review (DUR).

attributes.name: enrollment_eligibility_span_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_eligibility_span. Business justification: Required for claim adjudication to determine member's eligibility span at service date, supporting CMS reporting and accurate cost‑share calculations.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.header. Business justification: Required for integrated care reporting: links pharmacy claims to the corresponding medical claim header for episode‑of‑care analysis and coordinated benefits calculations.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the health plan or benefit plan under which this pharmacy claim was adjudicated. Links to the plan and benefit product. Determines formulary, cost-sharing rules, and CMS Part D contract identification.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Required for Claim Adjudication Posting process: each pharmacy claim expense must be posted to a GL ledger for financial reporting and regulatory audit.

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the health plan member who is the beneficiary of this pharmacy claim. Links to the member master record in the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT). Required for eligibility verification, coordination of benefits (COB), and CMS Part D risk adjustment (RAF/HCC).

attributes.name: prescriber_credential_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Claim adjudication requires verifying prescriber credentials per CMS regulations; linking claim to credential_record enables automated credential status checks.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the prior authorization record that approved dispensing of this drug, if applicable. Null when no PA was required. Links to the utilization management PA product. Required for specialty drug claims and step therapy override tracking.

attributes.name: processor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Claim Processing Audit Report to track which employee adjudicated each pharmacy claim.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the prescribing provider who authored the prescription. Links to the provider master record in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Used for prescriber profiling, fraud/waste/abuse (FWA) detection, and HEDIS measure attribution.

attributes.name: um_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to utilization.um_case. Business justification: Claims are associated with utilization‑management cases for case‑level cost analysis and outcome tracking, required by case management dashboards.

attributes.name: adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the pharmacy claim was adjudicated (approved or rejected) by the PBM system. Distinct from fill_date (dispensing event). Used for claims processing SLA measurement, 835 remittance matching, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: basis_of_cost_determination
attributes.description: Code indicating the pricing benchmark used to determine the ingredient cost for this claim. AWP = Average Wholesale Price; WAC = Wholesale Acquisition Cost; MAC = Maximum Allowable Cost; usual_and_customary = pharmacy's standard retail price; negotiated = contracted rate; 340B = 340B program pricing; other = alternative basis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awp|wac|mac|usual_and_customary|negotiated|340b|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable claim reference number assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus) at adjudication. Used for member communications, Explanation of Benefits (EOB), and 835 remittance reconciliation. Maps to NCPDP D.0 transaction reference number.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current adjudication lifecycle status of the pharmacy claim as determined by the PBM system. 'paid' = claim adjudicated and payment issued; 'rejected' = claim denied with reject code; 'reversed' = previously paid claim reversed; 'adjusted' = claim reprocessed with changed amounts; 'pending' = awaiting adjudication; 'void' = cancelled before processing.

attributes.name: cob_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination of benefits (COB) was applied on this claim (True = COB applied, another payer was involved). Triggers COB segment processing and other_payer_amount population. Used for COB reconciliation and CMS Part D TrOOP calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy claim record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA record retention requirements. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data-quality score for ECM scoring.

attributes.name: daw_code
attributes.description: NCPDP Dispense As Written (DAW) code indicating whether a brand drug was dispensed when a generic was available, and the reason. 0 = no product selection indicated; 1 = substitution not allowed by prescriber; 2 = substitution allowed, patient requested brand; 3 = substitution allowed, pharmacist selected brand; 4 = substitution allowed, generic not in stock; 5 = substitution allowed, brand dispensed as generic. Used for generic substitution rate analytics and formulary compliance.

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of medication supply dispensed on this claim as reported by the dispensing pharmacy. Used for refill-too-soon edits, medication adherence (MPR/PDC) calculations, HEDIS pharmacy measures, and CMS Part D days supply validation.

attributes.name: deductible_applied
attributes.description: Dollar amount of this pharmacy claim applied toward the member's pharmacy or combined medical/pharmacy deductible. Relevant for HDHP/HSA plans and CMS Part D deductible phase tracking. Contributes to OOP/MOOP accumulation.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the dispensing pharmacy for the act of dispensing the prescription, separate from ingredient cost. Negotiated as part of the PBM network contract. Used for PBM contract reconciliation and total claim cost analysis.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the dispensing pharmacy as submitted on the pharmacy claim. Denormalized for claim-level auditability and NCPDP D.0 compliance. Used for pharmacy network validation, audit trail, and CMS Part D encounter data.

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP standard code indicating the outcome of the prospective drug utilization review (DUR) edit performed during adjudication (e.g., drug-drug interaction, duplicate therapy, dose check). Null if no DUR alert was triggered. Critical for pharmacy safety and regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — NCPDP DUR outcome codes exceed 6 values]

Used for days supply calculations, refill-too-soon edits, and CMS Part D encounter data date of service reporting.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier assigned to the dispensed drug at the time of adjudication. Determines member cost-sharing (copay/coinsurance) and plan benefit design. Tier 1 = preferred generic; Tier 2 = generic; Tier 3 = preferred brand; Tier 4 = non-preferred brand; Tier 5 = specialty; non_formulary = not on formulary.

attributes.name: ingredient_cost
attributes.description: The cost of the drug ingredient(s) as billed by the dispensing pharmacy, before dispensing fee and other adjustments. Basis may be AWP, WAC, MAC, or negotiated rate. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for pharmacy claim financials. Used for PBM contract reconciliation and MLR calculation.

attributes.name: is_340b_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy claim was dispensed under the 340B Drug Pricing Program (True = 340B claim). Used for 340B duplicate discount prevention, HRSA compliance reporting, and separation of 340B and non-340B claims in financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Logical active flag for soft-delete and current-state filtering.

attributes.name: is_compound_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is for a compounded drug product containing multiple ingredients (True = compound claim). Compound claims require line-level detail in the pharmacy_claim_line product. Used for compound drug utilization review and cost management.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which this pharmacy claim was adjudicated. Drives regulatory reporting requirements, formulary rules, and cost-sharing structures. 'commercial' = employer-sponsored or individual; 'medicare_part_d' = CMS Medicare Part D; 'medicaid' = state Medicaid; 'exchange' = ACA marketplace QHP; 'cobra' = COBRA continuation coverage.

attributes.name: master_entity_reference
attributes.description: Cross-domain master/golden entity key for SSOT resolution.

attributes.name: member_coinsurance
attributes.description: Percentage-based cost-sharing amount paid by the member for this pharmacy claim, calculated as a percentage of the allowed cost. Applies when the benefit design uses coinsurance rather than fixed copay. Contributes to OOP/MOOP accumulation.

attributes.name: member_copay
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount paid by the member at point of sale as their cost-sharing obligation for this pharmacy claim. Determined by formulary tier and benefit design. Contributes to member out-of-pocket (OOP) and maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) accumulation.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product dispensed, including labeler, product, and package segment. Denormalized from the drug master for claim-level auditability and CMS Part D encounter data submission (EDPS). Required for 340B duplicate discount prevention and drug utilization review (DUR).

attributes.name: original_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number of the original pharmacy claim that this record adjusts or reverses. Populated only for adjusted or reversed claims; null for original claims. Enables claim adjustment chain tracing for financial reconciliation, audit, and CMS Part D encounter data correction submissions.

attributes.name: other_payer_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by another payer (secondary insurer, Medicare, Medicaid, manufacturer coupon) under coordination of benefits (COB). Used for COB reconciliation, 340B duplicate discount prevention, and CMS Part D TrOOP (True Out-of-Pocket) calculations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the drug was dispensed. Drives cost-sharing differentials, formulary tier rules, and network adequacy reporting. 'retail' = community pharmacy; 'mail_order' = 90-day mail service; 'specialty' = specialty pharmacy for high-cost/complex drugs; 'long_term_care' = SNF/LTC pharmacy; 'home_infusion' = infusion therapy at home.

attributes.name: plan_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the health plan for this pharmacy claim after applying member cost-sharing (copay, coinsurance, deductible) and COB adjustments. Net total component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for 835 remittance, MLR reporting, and CMS Part D encounter data.

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the prescribing provider as submitted on the pharmacy claim. Denormalized for claim-level auditability, NCPDP D.0 compliance, and CMS Part D encounter data submission. Used for prescriber fraud/waste/abuse (FWA) analytics.

attributes.name: prescription_written_date
attributes.description: Date the prescription was written by the prescriber. Used to validate prescription age, enforce days-supply-from-written-date rules, and support medication adherence analytics. Distinct from fill_date (dispensing date).

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the drug dispensed (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters, grams) as reported by the dispensing pharmacy. Used for quantity limit (QL) edits, drug utilization review (DUR), and CMS Part D encounter data submission.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: NCPDP standard unit of measure code for the quantity dispensed. EA = each (tablets/capsules); ML = milliliters; GM = grams; UN = units; F2 = international units; ME = milliequivalents. Required for accurate quantity limit (QL) edit enforcement and CMS Part D encounter data.

attributes.name: refill_number
attributes.description: Refill sequence number for this dispensing event. Zero (0) indicates the original fill; subsequent values indicate refill number. Used for refill-too-soon edits, medication adherence tracking, and prescription lifecycle management.

attributes.name: reject_code
attributes.description: NCPDP standard reject code returned by the PBM system when a claim is rejected or denied. Null for paid claims. Used for pharmacy operations, member appeals, and drug utilization review (DUR) outcome tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — NCPDP reject codes exceed 6 values]

attributes.name: sales_tax
attributes.description: Sales tax amount applied to the pharmacy claim where applicable by state law. Included in total claim cost and reported separately for financial reconciliation and statutory accounting (SAP) purposes.

attributes.name: step_therapy_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether a step therapy protocol was overridden for this claim (True = override applied). Step therapy requires trying lower-cost drugs before approving higher-cost alternatives. Override requires prior authorization. Used for utilization management (UM) reporting and CMS step therapy compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy claim record was last modified in the Silver layer, such as after a claim adjustment, reversal, or COB update. Supports change data capture (CDC) and audit trail requirements. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: pharmacy_contract
products.description: Contractual record governing the reimbursement terms between the health plan (or PBM on its behalf) and individual dispensing pharmacies or pharmacy chains. Captures pharmacy NPI, network tier (preferred/standard/specialty), dispensing fee schedule, ingredient cost basis (AWP discount/MAC/WAC), effective date range, contract type (direct/PBM-administered), performance requirements, and audit provisions. Distinct from pbm_contract which governs the PBM relationship.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmacy contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispensing pharmacy or pharmacy chain entity in the pharmacy master. Links this contract to the specific pharmacy party.

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the MAC pricing list applied under this contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. References the specific MAC schedule version used by the PBM or health plan. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is mac.

attributes.name: ncpdp_provider_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID
attributes.description: 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier used in pharmacy claim transactions (NCPDP Telecom D.0) and PBM adjudication. Complements the NPI for pharmacy-specific identification.

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this pharmacy dispensing agreement is administered, when the contract is PBM-administered rather than direct. Null for direct health-plan contracts.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Contracts are negotiated per network; linking contracts to provider_network enables contract‑level reporting, tiering, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Type of accreditation required or held by the pharmacy under this contract. URAC and ACHC are common for specialty pharmacies. PCAB (Pharmacy Compounding Accreditation Board) for compounding pharmacies. Relevant for specialty and mail-order contracts.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually stipulated frequency at which the health plan or PBM may conduct pharmacy audits. Applicable when audit_rights_indicator is true.

attributes.name: audit_rights_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan or PBM retains the right to conduct on-site or desk audits of the pharmacy's dispensing records under this contract. Required for CMS Part D compliance.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless either party provides notice of termination within the required notice period.

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the drug's Average Wholesale Price (AWP) to determine ingredient cost reimbursement for brand and generic drugs. Expressed as a positive percentage (e.g., 16.50 = AWP minus 16.50%). Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is awp_discount.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM. Used in correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pharmacy contract. Active contracts are eligible for claim adjudication. Suspended contracts are temporarily ineligible. Terminated/expired contracts are closed. Drives network eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual relationship: direct (health plan contracts directly with pharmacy), pbm_administered (PBM manages on plan's behalf), chain (multi-location chain agreement), independent (single-location independent pharmacy), mail_order, or specialty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|pbm_administered|chain|independent|mail_order|specialty — promote to reference product]

attributes.description: Standard ECM audit/governance attribute created_timestamp.

attributes.name: credentialing_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy must complete and maintain credentialing requirements (state licensure, DEA registration, accreditation) as a condition of this contract.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data-quality score for ECM scoring.

attributes.name: days_supply_mail_max
attributes.description: Maximum days supply per mail-order prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 90 days). Drives adjudication edits in RxClaim/Argus.

attributes.name: days_supply_retail_max
attributes.description: Maximum days supply per retail prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 30 or 34 days). Claims exceeding this limit may be rejected during adjudication.

attributes.name: dispensing_channel
attributes.description: The dispensing channel(s) authorized under this contract. Retail covers walk-in pharmacies; mail_order covers 90-day supply dispensing; specialty covers high-cost/complex drugs; long_term_care covers SNF/LTC facilities; home_infusion covers IV therapy.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail_order
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per mail-order prescription dispensed. Typically lower than retail due to higher volume and automation. Applicable for mail-order and specialty pharmacy contracts.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per retail prescription dispensed, in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. A core financial term of the pharmacy contract.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per specialty drug prescription dispensed. Specialty drugs require enhanced clinical services, justifying a separate fee schedule.

attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract becomes binding and the pharmacy is eligible to dispense claims under this agreement. Used for network eligibility validation during adjudication.

domains.name: utilization
domains.description: Manages utilization management (UM) and prior authorization (PA) workflows — inpatient concurrent review, retrospective review, medical necessity determination, peer-to-peer processes, and UM turnaround time compliance. Owns PA requests, clinical criteria application (InterQual, MCG), authorization decisions, length-of-stay benchmarks, and denial reasons. Supports NCQA UM accreditation standards and state PA reform mandates. Source system: InterQual or MCG.

products.name: pa_request
products.description: Core master entity representing a prior authorization (PA) request submitted by a provider or member for a proposed service, procedure, drug, or admission. Captures requesting provider NPI, member ID, requested service codes (CPT/HCPCS/ICD), urgency type (standard, expedited, urgent), submission channel (portal, fax, phone, EDI 278), submission timestamp, current PA status, and full status transition history. Also tracks additional information requests (AIRs) issued during review — information type requested, requested-from party, due date, received date, and TAT clock extension impact. Authoritative SSOT for all PA requests, their status lifecycle, and associated documentation requests.

products.name: pa_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the authorization decision and underlying medical necessity determination rendered on a PA request. Stores decision date, decision type (approved, denied, partially approved, pended, withdrawn), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG criteria set, version, effective date), criteria met/not met flag, clinical rationale narrative, ICD diagnosis codes supporting the determination, deciding reviewer NPI and credentials (MD, RN, PharmD), denial reason code and category (medical necessity, administrative, benefit exclusion, out-of-network, experimental/investigational), denial regulatory citation, appeal eligibility flag, and effective authorization period (start/end dates). Each PA request may have one or more decision records reflecting amendments, P2P reversals, or appeal overrides. Serves as the single evidentiary record for NCQA audits, state DOI market conduct exams, and denial defense.

products.name: concurrent_review
products.description: Manages inpatient concurrent review records for admitted members — the ongoing UM review process evaluating continued medical necessity during a hospital stay. products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a utilization management program and an employer group. The enrollment is actively managed, with start/end dates and contribution strategy captured for each enrollment. This relationship is therefore a true many‑to‑many operational entity.

domains.description: Manages the provider credentialing and re-credentialing lifecycle — primary source verification (PSV), NCQA credentialing standards, committee decisions, sanctions screening (OIG/SAM), DEA and state license validation, malpractice history, hospital privileges verification, and credentialing event history. products.name: application
products.description: Core master record for a provider credentialing or re-credentialing application submitted to the health plan. Captures the full lifecycle of the credentialing request — application date, application type (initial, re-credential, reinstatement), submission channel (paper, portal, CVO, delegated entity), current workflow status (received, in-review, PSV-in-progress, committee-ready, decided, closed), assigned credentialing specialist, NCQA credentialing cycle, target completion date, expiration date, and overall disposition. This is the central orchestrating entity — all downstream verification activities (PSV), sanctions screenings, NPDB queries, committee reviews, attestations, and outreach communications link back to this application. Sourced from CAQH ProView, Cactus, ProviderSource, or direct submission.

products.name: psv_verification
products.description: Unified master record for each credential element held by a provider and its primary source verification (PSV). This is the SOLE authoritative product (SSOT) for ALL verifiable credential element types — no other product in this domain stores credential element data. Supported element types include: state professional licenses (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN, LCSW), DEA controlled substance registrations (with schedules II-V), specialty board certifications (ABMS, AOA, ABPS with MOC status), professional liability (malpractice) insurance (occurrence/claims-made, per-occurrence and aggregate limits, tail coverage), hospital clinical privileges (admitting, surgical, procedural, courtesy), graduate medical education and training (medical school, residency, fellowship, ECFMG for IMGs), and professional work history (5-year history with gap explanations per NCQA). Each record stores: element type discriminator, issuing/granting authority, element-specific attributes (number, schedules, limits, scope, restrictions), effective and expiration dates, current status, PSV source contacted (FSMB, AMA, ABMS, NPDB, OIG, DEA Diversion Control, state boards, facilities, carriers, ECFMG), verification method, verification date, verification result (verified, unable to verify, discrepancy), and verifier identity. One record per credential element per provider per application cycle. Core to NCQA CR 1-4 compliance.
products.reference: NCQA PSV Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

products.name: sanction_screening
products.description: Consolidated record for the full sanctions and exclusions lifecycle — both screening events and confirmed adverse findings. Captures each screening event (date, type — initial/monthly routine/triggered, databases queried including OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, state Medicaid exclusion lists, NPDB, screening result — clear/match found/pending review, resolution status) and each confirmed sanction, exclusion, or disciplinary action (sanction type, sanctioning authority, effective/end dates, severity, impact on credentialing status). Confirmed sanctions drive automatic credentialing holds and committee escalation. Links to application for initial/re-credentialing screenings; routine monthly screenings may exist independently.

products.name: contract_link
products.description: Represents the assignment of a vendor contract to a provider credential record. Each row captures the contract role (primary, supplemental, etc.) and the period during which the contract covers the credential.. Existence Justification: A credential record represents a provider's credentialing status with a health plan. Multiple vendor contracts can cover the same credential record (e.g., primary and supplemental credentialing services), and each vendor contract can cover many credential records across providers. The business actively creates, updates, and deletes these links and tracks role, effective and expiration dates for each coverage.

products.name: obligation_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the mapping between a credential record and a regulatory obligation. It captures the effective and expiration dates that define when a specific credential satisfies a particular regulatory requirement.. Existence Justification: A credential record can satisfy multiple regulatory obligations (e.g., NCQA, HIPAA) and a single regulatory obligation must be satisfied by many credential records across providers. The business actively tracks each credential‑obligation pairing with effective and expiration dates, making the relationship a true many‑to‑many operational entity.

products.name: finding
products.description: Represents the operational link between a provider's credential record and an audit finding. Each row records that a particular finding applies to a specific credential and captures attributes that belong only to this relationship.. Existence Justification: During audit engagements, auditors associate each audit finding with the specific provider credential records that are impacted. A single finding can affect multiple credential records, and a single credential record can be the subject of multiple findings over time. The link is actively created, updated, and tracked as part of the audit remediation process.

products.name: adequacy_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining all network compliance standards by specialty, facility type, and geographic area — encompassing time-distance standards (e.g., 30 miles/30 minutes for PCPs), provider-to-member ratios, appointment access wait-time standards (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), after-hours availability requirements, and telehealth equivalency rules. Captures regulatory source (CMS, state DOI, NCQA, URAC), standard category (time-distance, provider-ratio, appointment-access, after-hours, telehealth-equivalency), specialty category, geographic classification (urban, suburban, rural, frontier), maximum wait time in days, threshold values, and after-hours availability flag. This is the single source of truth for all network adequacy and access compliance standards — both geographic access (time-distance, ratios) and appointment access (wait times, after-hours). Used to evaluate compliance in adequacy assessments, access surveys, and CMS/state regulatory filings.

products.name: adequacy_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a network compliance evaluation — including network adequacy assessments, access surveys, mystery shopper studies, and gap identification. Captures assessment type (adequacy, access-survey, mystery-shopper), assessment date, regulatory submission type (CMS, state DOI), specialty/facility type evaluated, provider counts, member-to-provider ratios, time-distance compliance results, wait-time measurements, survey method (member survey, secret shopper call), appointment type requested, telehealth offered flag, and overall compliance outcome. Includes detail-level gap findings as child records: specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area, gap severity, number of providers available vs. required, remediation actions taken, and resolution status. Supports CMS network adequacy filings, NCQA HEDIS access measures (Getting Care Quickly), CAHPS survey supplementation, and targeted network development. This is the SSOT for all network compliance evaluations and their associated gap findings.

products.name: provider_directory
products.description: Published provider directory record representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation, including full verification lifecycle tracking. Captures provider name, specialty, practice location, phone, accepting-new-patients status, telehealth availability, languages spoken, accessibility features (ADA compliance), last verified date, and directory publication channel (online, print, API). Embeds complete verification history as child records — including verification method (outbound call, online attestation, EHR/HIE data match, claims-based inference), verification date, verified fields (address, phone, accepting-new-patients, specialty), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach), and verifying agent/system. Supports CMS directory accuracy requirements (42 CFR 422.111), No Surprises Act compliance, the 90-day directory update mandate, and quarterly verification tracking. This is the SSOT for member-facing directory data and its verification audit trail.

products.name: vbc_arrangement
products.description: Master entity representing Value-Based Care (VBC) programs and their participation arrangements — covering both program design (program type, sponsoring entity, quality measure set, risk model, benchmark methodology) and specific ACO/VBC participation instances (ACO name, CMS ACO ID, arrangement dates, shared savings/risk terms, participating provider groups). Supports MSSP, Next Gen, REACH, commercial P4P, episode-based payment, and capitation models. Records may represent a program definition (template) or a specific arrangement instance (participation record), distinguished by record type. Owned by the network domain as the structural participation record — financial settlement terms are owned by the contract domain.

products.name: change_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all material changes to provider network composition — provider additions, terminations (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), tier reassignments, panel status changes, and service area modifications. For terminations, captures termination type, continuity-of-care obligation period, termination reason code, member transition planning, notice date, and member notification status. For all change types, records change type, effective date, impacted provider NPI, change reason, member impact count, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS 30-day member notification requirements, state DOI network change and termination notification filings, continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act, and network stability monitoring. This is the SSOT for all network composition changes including terminations — replaces the need for a separate termination entity.

products.name: access_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining appointment access and availability standards for the network — capturing standard type (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), specialty category, maximum wait time in days, after-hours availability requirement, telehealth equivalency flag, and the regulatory or accreditation source (NCQA, URAC, state DOI, CMS). products.name: termination
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal termination of a provider from a network — including voluntary and involuntary terminations. Records termination type (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), effective date, notice date, termination reason code, member impact count, continuity-of-care obligation period, member notification status, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS and state DOI termination notification requirements and continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act.

Tracks case submission date, group census data, prior carrier loss experience, medical underwriting status, risk tier assignment, manual rate basis; rating factors including age/gender composite factors, geographic area rating factors, industry risk factors, experience rating credibility weights, ACA-compliant rating adjustments, and actuarial basis documentation; underwriting decision (approved, declined, modified); and premium rate quotes with proposed rates by plan, coverage tier, and rating area, quote effective and expiration dates, rating methodology (community rated, experience rated, blended), proposed PMPM rates, total group premium estimate, and quote status (draft, presented, accepted, expired). Consolidates rating factors and rate quotes as stages within the underwriting case lifecycle. Links to the risk domain for RAF and HCC-based risk scoring at the group level. domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: add column legal_entity_id (BIGINT) with FK to finance.legal_entity.legal_entity_id - internal contract parties are legal entities

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Party represents a provider entity in a contract; linking to its credential record enables tracking of credential status and compliance per party.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Contract Party Management report requires linking party records to vendor master to identify vendor parties (e.g., TPAs) for compliance and payment processing.

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.

attributes.name: contract_party_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this party within the contract management system (e.g., Cactus or ProviderSource provider contract number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI transactions, and provider directory publication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Standard ECM audit/governance attribute created_timestamp.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party was most recently credentialed or re-credentialed by the health plan. NCQA requires re-credentialing every 36 months. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows and network compliance reporting.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the party as maintained in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Determines whether the party is eligible to provide services to plan members. Credentialing must be current for claims to be adjudicated as in-network.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data-quality score for ECM scoring.

attributes.name: delegation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a delegated entity authorized to perform functions on behalf of the health plan (e.g., credentialing, utilization management, claims processing). Triggers delegation oversight and audit requirements per NCQA and state DOI standards.

attributes.name: delegation_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the functional scope of delegation authority granted to this party. Applicable only when delegation_indicator is true. Defines which health plan functions the delegated entity is authorized to perform on behalf of the payer.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the party operates, if different from the legal entity name. Commonly used for group practices and hospital systems that operate under a brand name distinct from their legal registration.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective. Drives claims adjudication eligibility windows, network directory publication, and provider credentialing timelines.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end of the record validity window.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start of the record validity window.

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: Employer Identification Number

attributes.name: fhir_last_updated
attributes.description: FHIR meta.lastUpdated for resource versioning

attributes.name: fhir_profile_url
attributes.description: Canonical FHIR/US Core profile URL this record conforms to

attributes.name: fhir_resource_reference
attributes.description: Stable FHIR logical resource id for interop exchange

attributes.name: fhir_resource_type
attributes.description: FHIR resource type this record maps to for interoperability (default: Basic)

attributes.name: fhir_version_code
attributes.description: FHIR meta.versionId optimistic concurrency token

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Logical active flag for soft-delete and current-state filtering.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's primary state professional or business license expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification workflows and may result in contract suspension if not renewed. Critical for NCQA and URAC credentialing compliance.

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the party holds its primary professional or business license. Used for network adequacy reporting, credentialing, and state-specific regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business under which this party is contracted. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and network adequacy standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|fehb — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage as required by the contract. Failure to maintain coverage may trigger contract suspension or termination per NCQA credentialing standards.

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification and contract compliance monitoring workflows.

attributes.name: master_entity_reference
attributes.description: Cross-domain master/golden entity key for SSOT resolution.

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a participating (PAR) in-network provider, a non-participating (non-PAR) provider, or an out-of-network provider. Drives member cost-sharing calculations, claims adjudication rules, and EOB generation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplemental information about the party that does not fit structured attributes. May include contract negotiation notes, special arrangement details, or credentialing exceptions. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider party. Type 1 NPI for individual providers; Type 2 NPI for organizational providers. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions including 837 claims and 270/271 eligibility inquiries.

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPI is Type 1 (individual/solo practitioner) or Type 2 (organizational entity such as group practice, hospital, or IPA). Determines credentialing requirements and contract structure.

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded parties are prohibited from participating in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal healthcare programs. Checked monthly per CMS compliance requirements.

tag_set.value: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this party within the contract relationship. Identifies whether the party is the health plan (payer), a contracting provider, a delegated entity, an Independent Practice Association (IPA), an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), a hospital system, or a group practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|provider|delegated_entity|ipa|aco|hospital_system|group_practice — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party within the contract. Indicates whether the party is actively bound by the contract, pending execution, suspended, terminated, or inactive. Drives eligibility verification and claims adjudication routing.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as an individual (natural person, e.g., solo practitioner with individual NPI) or an organization (legal entity, e.g., group practice, hospital, IPA, ACO). Drives NPI type assignment and credentialing workflow.

attributes.name: primary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's primary clinical specialty. Used for network adequacy analysis, claims routing, prior authorization rules, and provider directory classification.

attributes.name: raf_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scoring applies to this party's contract arrangement. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace contracts where Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk scores drive capitation payments.

attributes.name: record_created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp the record was created (audit lineage).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: System of record / source system that produced this record (SSOT provenance).

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Standard ECM audit/governance attribute record_status.

attributes.name: record_updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp the record was last updated (audit lineage).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and SCD Type 2 processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Optimistic-concurrency / change version of the record.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the party must complete re-credentialing to maintain active network participation. Calculated as 36 months from the credentialing_date per NCQA standards. Drives automated re-credentialing workflow initiation.

attributes.name: role_code
attributes.description: Role of the party in the contract

attributes.name: sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has an active sanction, exclusion, or adverse action recorded by OIG, SAM, or state licensing boards. A true value triggers contract suspension review and claims payment hold per CMS and HIPAA compliance requirements.

products.name: term
products.description: Defines the specific terms, conditions, obligations, and reimbursement policies within a provider contract. Captures term type (payment methodology, exclusivity, termination clause, audit rights, hold-harmless, indemnification, confidentiality, HIPAA BAA, reimbursement rule), term text, effective date, expiration date, and whether the term is negotiable or standard boilerplate. For reimbursement rule terms: captures policy sub-type (multiple procedure reduction, bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, global surgery, unbundling rules, place-of-service differential), applicable CPT/HCPCS ranges, reduction percentage, and LOB applicability. Enables granular tracking of contractual obligations, compliance checkpoints, and reimbursement adjudication rules. Bridges contract terms to claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: term_id

attributes.name: amendment_id

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id

attributes.name: auto_renew

attributes.name: capitation_rate

attributes.name: compliance_checkpoint_date

attributes.name: drg_grouper_version

attributes.name: governing_state

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_required

attributes.name: is_standard_boilerplate

attributes.name: lob_applicability

attributes.name: mac_pricing_basis

Applicable for terms covering pharmacy benefits.

attributes.name: source_system_term_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this term record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus contract clause ID, QNXT reimbursement rule ID, or ProviderSource term reference). Supports data lineage and reconciliation with source systems.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Plain-language operational summary of the term's intent and impact, authored by the contracting team. Used for training, audits, and quick reference without reading full legal text.

attributes.name: term_number
